Official Apple refurb store has the lowest prices on MacBook Neo, up to $120 off list price

Alongside the MacBook Air and M5 series MacBook Pro, Apple’s much more affordable new MacBook Neo also saw a price hike recently, but you can side step that by way of the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store – MacBook Neo starts at $689 at Amazon, but you can score one from the best Apple refurbished store there is with a full Apple warranty from $599.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store carries all of the MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we can find from a source even half as reputable, and, again, with a proper Apple warranty as well as Apple’s “rigorous” refurbishment seal of approval.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

While it does not look like there are special offers on these machines when you pull up the listing pages on the Apple refurb store, they are all at least $100 under the new MSRP – the 512GB model with the Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 off the new list price and $20 under the previous list price.

Yes, they are refurb units and, yes, they are really just bringing the price back down, or very close, to the old MSRPs, but we are also talking about the lowest prices on the most affordable current-generation MacBook here.

For some, the $100 to $120 in savings isn’t worth going for a refurbished unit, and understandably so, but this is certainly not an insignificant amount of cash and we are talking about the best quality refurbished you can buy straight from Apple.

All of this machines ship with:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

If it’s the M5 MacBook Air or MacBook Pro you’re after, scope out the Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers on those below, followed by the best new condition unit deals we are tracking this week:

Official Apple MagSafe Battery drops back to all-time low pricing at 40% off

We have had a steady run at deals on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery and, after quickly popping back up to full price yesterday, Amazon is giving us another shot at the 40% off all-time low deal price.

Amazon is now once again offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back down at $59 shipped.

You’re looking at Apple’s tailored-made magnetic power bank that would cost $99 if you bought it just about anywhere else.

This deal is one we have tracked more than a few times over the last four months or so, but it is also on par with the best discount we have ever seen since Apple debuted its add-on battery pack for iPhone Air back in September.

Deals started to pop nearer the top of the year down into the $79 range, but with early summer came far more impressive discounts and we are indeed getting another go at it here again.

As I, and many others, have said in the past, this is by no means the most affordable MagSafe power bank you can buy, but neither is just about anything else with an official Apple logo on it.

It is, however, one of the most elegant solutions you can buy if you ask me, lining up perfectly with the backside of your Air and providing 65% additional charge in one of the thinnest packages out there.

If you’re not sold on the Apple treatment here, I tend to lean towards options like the Anker Nano Magnetic Power Bank or the TORRAS MiniMag Power Bank.
